description:
Activate Slimefoot by paying {4}.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Slimefoot's ability.
Resolve both Slimefoot abilities, creating four creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing the four creature tokens, adding {4}.
When the creature tokens die, Slimefoot triggers four times, dealing 4 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat
